scripts.script:
--// VOID SPAM UI
--// For your own Roblox experience / Studio testing

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

--==================================================
-- SETTINGS
--==================================================

local DEFAULT_DISTANCE = 150
local DEFAULT_VOID_TIME = 0.35
local DEFAULT_RETURN_TIME = 0.35

local VOID_DISTANCE = DEFAULT_DISTANCE
local VOID_TIME = DEFAULT_VOID_TIME
local RETURN_TIME = DEFAULT_RETURN_TIME

local enabled = false
local stableCamera = true
local busy = false
local minimized = false

--==================================================
-- GUI
--==================================================

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "VoidSpamUI"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(310, 380)
main.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -155, 0.5, -190)
main.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(24, 24, 31)
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Parent = gui

local mainCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
mainCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
mainCorner.Parent = main

--==================================================
-- TITLE BAR
--==================================================

local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 48)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(32, 32, 41)
titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleBar.Parent = main

local titleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
titleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 14)
titleCorner.Parent = titleBar

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -100, 1, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "VOID SPAM"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
title.TextSize = 17
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = titleBar

--==================================================
-- MINIMIZE
--==================================================

local minimize = Instance.new("TextButton")
minimize.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 30)
minimize.Position = UDim2.new(1, -76, 0, 9)
minimize.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 67)
minimize.Text = "—"
minimize.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
minimize.TextSize = 18
minimize.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
minimize.Parent = titleBar

local minCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
minCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
minCorner.Parent = minimize

--==================================================
-- CLOSE
--==================================================

local close = Instance.new("TextButton")
close.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(34, 30)
close.Position = UDim2.new(1, -38, 0, 9)
close.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 45, 55)
close.Text = "×"
close.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
close.TextSize = 20
close.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
close.Parent = titleBar

local closeCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
closeCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
closeCorner.Parent = close

--==================================================
-- CONTENT CONTAINER
--==================================================

local content = Instance.new("Frame")
content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -48)
content.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 48)
content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
content.Parent = main

--==================================================
-- TOGGLE
--==================================================

local toggle = Instance.new("TextButton")
toggle.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 44)
toggle.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 15)
toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 67)
toggle.Text = "VOID: OFF"
toggle.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
toggle.TextSize = 15
toggle.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
toggle.Parent = content

local toggleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
toggleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
toggleCorner.Parent = toggle

--==================================================
-- SLIDER CREATOR
--==================================================

local sliders = {}

local function createSlider(name, y, minValue, maxValue, defaultValue, suffix)

	local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	label.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 24)
	label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, y)
	label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	label.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(220, 220, 225)
	label.TextSize = 13
	label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
	label.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	label.Parent = content

	local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
	bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 7)
	bar.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, y + 30)
	bar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
	bar.BorderSizePixel = 0
	bar.Parent = content

	local barCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	barCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	barCorner.Parent = bar

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 80, 220)
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = bar

	local fillCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	fillCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	fillCorner.Parent = fill

	local knob = Instance.new("TextButton")
	knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
	knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	knob.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	knob.Text = ""
	knob.Parent = bar

	local knobCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
	knobCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	knobCorner.Parent = knob

	local value = defaultValue
	local dragging = false

	local function update(newValue)

		value = math.clamp(newValue, minValue, maxValue)

		local percent =
			(value - minValue) /
			(maxValue - minValue)

		fill.Size = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 1, 0)
		knob.Position = UDim2.new(percent, 0, 0.5, 0)

		if maxValue - minValue >= 10 then
			label.Text =
				name .. ": " .. math.floor(value + 0.5) .. suffix
		else
			label.Text =
				name .. ": " .. string.format("%.2f", value) .. suffix
		end
	end

	local function setFromX(x)

		local percent =
			(x - bar.AbsolutePosition.X) /
			bar.AbsoluteSize.X

		update(
			minValue +
			(maxValue - minValue) *
			math.clamp(percent, 0, 1)
		)
	end

	bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
			setFromX(input.Position.X)
		end
	end)

	knob.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = true
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

		if dragging then

			if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
			or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

				setFromX(input.Position.X)
			end
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			dragging = false
		end
	end)

	update(defaultValue)

	local slider = {}

	function slider:Get()
		return value
	end

	function slider:Set(newValue)
		update(newValue)
	end

	return slider
end

--==================================================
-- SLIDERS
--==================================================

local distanceSlider = createSlider(
	"Void Distance",
	75,
	10,
	500,
	DEFAULT_DISTANCE,
	" studs"
)

local voidTimeSlider = createSlider(
	"Void Time",
	135,
	0.01,
	1,
	DEFAULT_VOID_TIME,
	" sec"
)

local returnTimeSlider = createSlider(
	"Return Time",
	195,
	0.01,
	1,
	DEFAULT_RETURN_TIME,
	" sec"
)

--==================================================
-- STABLE CAMERA
--==================================================

local cameraButton = Instance.new("TextButton")
cameraButton.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 40)
cameraButton.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 255)
cameraButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 125, 75)
cameraButton.Text = "STABLE CAMERA: ON"
cameraButton.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
cameraButton.TextSize = 13
cameraButton.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
cameraButton.Parent = content

local cameraCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
cameraCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
cameraCorner.Parent = cameraButton

--==================================================
-- RESET
--==================================================

local reset = Instance.new("TextButton")
reset.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 38)
reset.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(15, 305)
reset.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(48, 48, 59)
reset.Text = "RESET SETTINGS"
reset.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 235, 235)
reset.TextSize = 13
reset.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
reset.Parent = content

local resetCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
resetCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 9)
resetCorner.Parent = reset

--==================================================
-- TOGGLE
--==================================================

toggle.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	enabled = not enabled

	if enabled then
		toggle.Text = "VOID: ON"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 125, 75)
	else
		toggle.Text = "VOID: OFF"
		toggle.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 67)
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- CAMERA TOGGLE
--==================================================

cameraButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	stableCamera = not stableCamera

	if stableCamera then
		cameraButton.Text = "STABLE CAMERA: ON"
		cameraButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 125, 75)
	else
		cameraButton.Text = "STABLE CAMERA: OFF"
		cameraButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 67)
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- RESET
--==================================================

reset.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	distanceSlider:Set(DEFAULT_DISTANCE)
	voidTimeSlider:Set(DEFAULT_VOID_TIME)
	returnTimeSlider:Set(DEFAULT_RETURN_TIME)

	stableCamera = true
	cameraButton.Text = "STABLE CAMERA: ON"
	cameraButton.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 125, 75)
end)

--==================================================
-- CHARACTER
--==================================================

local function getCharacter()

	local character = player.Character
		or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

	local root =
		character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

	if root then
		return character, root
	end
end

--==================================================
-- VOID LOOP
--==================================================

task.spawn(function()

	while gui.Parent do

		task.wait(0.01)

		if enabled and not busy then

			local character, root = getCharacter()

			if character and root then

				busy = true

				local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

				-- Save camera position before teleport
				local savedCameraCFrame

				if stableCamera and camera then
					savedCameraCFrame = camera.CFrame
				end

				-- Save player position
				local returnCFrame = root.CFrame

				VOID_DISTANCE = distanceSlider:Get()
				VOID_TIME = voidTimeSlider:Get()
				RETURN_TIME = returnTimeSlider:Get()

				-- Teleport downward
				root.CFrame =
					returnCFrame *
					CFrame.new(0, -VOID_DISTANCE, 0)

				-- Keep camera visually stable
				if stableCamera and camera and savedCameraCFrame then

					local endTime =
						os.clock() + VOID_TIME

					while os.clock() < endTime do

						if camera and camera.Parent then
							camera.CFrame = savedCameraCFrame
						end

						task.wait()
					end

				else
					task.wait(VOID_TIME)
				end

				-- Return player
				if root and root.Parent then
					root.CFrame = returnCFrame
				end

				-- Restore camera again
				if stableCamera and camera and savedCameraCFrame then
					camera.CFrame = savedCameraCFrame
				end

				task.wait(RETURN_TIME)

				busy = false
			end
		end
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- MINIMIZE / RESTORE
--==================================================

minimize.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	minimized = not minimized

	if minimized then

		-- Hide content
		content.Visible = false

		-- Shrink window
		main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(310, 48)

		-- Change button
		minimize.Text = "□"

	else

		-- Restore window
		main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(310, 380)

		-- Show content
		content.Visible = true

		minimize.Text = "—"
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- CLOSE
--==================================================

close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()

	enabled = false

	if workspace.CurrentCamera then
		workspace.CurrentCamera.CameraType =
			Enum.CameraType.Custom
	end

	gui:Destroy()
end)

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================

local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
	or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPosition = main.Position
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)

	if dragging then

		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

			local delta =
				input.Position - dragStart

			main.Position = UDim2.new(
				startPosition.X.Scale,
				startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
				startPosition.Y.Scale,
				startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
			)
		end
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)

	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
	or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		dragging = false
	end
end)

--==================================================
-- RESPAWN SAFETY
--==================================================

player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()

	busy = false
end)

scripts.title: Fly GUI [GTFA]
scripts.script:
-- FlyGui LocalScript
-- Put this in: StarterPlayer > StarterPlayerScripts (as a LocalScript)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Settings
local flySpeed = 50
local MIN_SPEED, MAX_SPEED = 1, 1000
local flying = false
local flyConnection
local bodyVelocity, bodyGyro

-- ========== GUI ==========
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "FlyGui"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
mainFrame.Name = "Main"
mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 150)
mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -130, 0.4, 0)
mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 38)
mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
mainFrame.ClipsDescendants = true
mainFrame.Parent = screenGui
Instance.new("UICorner", mainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

-- Title bar (drag handle)
local titleBar = Instance.new("Frame")
titleBar.Name = "TitleBar"
titleBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
titleBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 58)
titleBar.BorderSizePixel = 0
titleBar.Parent = mainFrame

local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -80, 1, 0)
title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 0)
title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
title.Text = "Fly GUI"
title.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
title.TextSize = 14
title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
title.Parent = titleBar

-- Close (X) button - top right
local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
closeBtn.Name = "Close"
closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 0)
closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
closeBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
closeBtn.Text = "X"
closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
closeBtn.TextSize = 14
closeBtn.Parent = titleBar

-- Minimize (-) button - next to X
local minBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
minBtn.Name = "Minimize"
minBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)
minBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -60, 0, 0)
minBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(90, 90, 110)
minBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
minBtn.Text = "-"
minBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
minBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
minBtn.TextSize = 18
minBtn.Parent = titleBar

-- Content area
local content = Instance.new("Frame")
content.Name = "Content"
content.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, -30)
content.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 30)
content.BackgroundTransparency = 1
content.Parent = mainFrame

local speedLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
speedLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 90, 0, 30)
speedLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 15)
speedLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
speedLabel.Text = "Fly Speed:"
speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
speedLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
speedLabel.TextSize = 14
speedLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
speedLabel.Parent = content

local speedBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
speedBox.Name = "SpeedBox"
speedBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 30)
speedBox.Position = UDim2.new(0, 120, 0, 15)
speedBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 70)
speedBox.BorderSizePixel = 0
speedBox.Text = tostring(flySpeed)
speedBox.PlaceholderText = "Type speed"
speedBox.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
speedBox.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
speedBox.TextSize = 14
speedBox.ClearTextOnFocus = false
speedBox.Parent = content
Instance.new("UICorner", speedBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local flyBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
flyBtn.Name = "FlyToggle"
flyBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 38)
flyBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0, 15, 0, 62)
flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
flyBtn.BorderSizePixel = 0
flyBtn.Text = "Fly: OFF"
flyBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
flyBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
flyBtn.TextSize = 16
flyBtn.Parent = content
Instance.new("UICorner", flyBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

-- ========== FLY LOGIC ==========
local function getCharacterParts()
	local char = player.Character
	if not char then return end
	local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	return char, root, hum
end

local function stopFly()
	flying = false
	if flyConnection then
		flyConnection:Disconnect()
		flyConnection = nil
	end
	if bodyVelocity then bodyVelocity:Destroy() bodyVelocity = nil end
	if bodyGyro then bodyGyro:Destroy() bodyGyro = nil end

	local _, _, hum = getCharacterParts()
	if hum then hum.PlatformStand = false end

	flyBtn.Text = "Fly: OFF"
	flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 60, 60)
end

local function startFly()
	local _, root, hum = getCharacterParts()
	if not root or not hum then return end

	flying = true
	hum.PlatformStand = true

	bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
	bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.zero
	bodyVelocity.Parent = root

	bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
	bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
	bodyGyro.P = 9e4
	bodyGyro.CFrame = camera.CFrame
	bodyGyro.Parent = root

	flyBtn.Text = "Fly: ON"
	flyBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 180, 90)

	flyConnection = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		local _, r, h = getCharacterParts()
		if not r or not h or not bodyVelocity then
			stopFly()
			return
		end

		camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local camCF = camera.CFrame
		local direction = Vector3.zero

		-- WASD / mobile thumbstick (relative to where the camera looks)
		local moveDir = h.MoveDirection
		if moveDir.Magnitude > 0 then
			local flatLook = Vector3.new(camCF.LookVector.X, 0, camCF.LookVector.Z)
			local flatRight = Vector3.new(camCF.RightVector.X, 0, camCF.RightVector.Z)
			if flatLook.Magnitude > 0.001 then flatLook = flatLook.Unit end
			if flatRight.Magnitude > 0.001 then flatRight = flatRight.Unit end
			local forwardAmt = moveDir:Dot(flatLook)
			local rightAmt = moveDir:Dot(flatRight)
			direction = camCF.LookVector * forwardAmt + camCF.RightVector * rightAmt
		end

		-- Up / down (only when not typing in a textbox)
		if not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then
				direction += Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end
			if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl)
				or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
				direction -= Vector3.new(0, 1, 0)
			end
		end

		if direction.Magnitude > 0 then
			direction = direction.Unit
		end

		bodyVelocity.Velocity = direction * flySpeed
		bodyGyro.CFrame = camCF
	end)
end

local function toggleFly()
	if flying then
		stopFly()
	else
		startFly()
	end
end

-- ========== BUTTON EVENTS ==========
flyBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(toggleFly)

speedBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
	local value = tonumber(speedBox.Text)
	if value then
		flySpeed = math.clamp(value, MIN_SPEED, MAX_SPEED)
	end
	speedBox.Text = tostring(flySpeed) -- reset invalid input to the current speed
end)

local minimized = false
minBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	minimized = not minimized
	content.Visible = not minimized
	mainFrame.Size = minimized and UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 30) or UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 150)
	minBtn.Text = minimized and "+" or "-"
end)

closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	stopFly()
	screenGui:Destroy()
end)

-- Turn fly off if the character respawns
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function()
	if flying then stopFly() end
end)

-- ========== DRAGGING ==========
local dragging, dragStart, startPos

titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
		dragging = true
		dragStart = input.Position
		startPos = mainFrame.Position
		input.Changed:Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
				dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
	if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(
			startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X,
			startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y
		)
	end
end)

local function getHRP()

        saveDot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 220, 255)

local function performSafeTeleport()
    local targetCFrame = getgenv().TeleportSavedCFrame
    if not targetCFrame then return false end
    
    local hrp = getHRP()
    if not hrp then return false end

    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero

    local currentPos = hrp.Position
    local targetPos = targetCFrame.Position
    local distance = (targetPos - currentPos).Magnitude

    if distance > STEP_DISTANCE then
        local steps = math.ceil(distance / STEP_DISTANCE)
        for i = 1, steps do
            if not hrp or not hrp.Parent then break end
            local alpha = i / steps
            hrp.CFrame = currentPos:Lerp(targetPos, alpha) * targetCFrame.Rotation
            hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
            task.wait()
        end
    else
        hrp.CFrame = targetCFrame
    end

    hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    return true
end

        task.wait(1.5)

--==================================================
-- HIDE CHARACTER
--==================================================

local function HideCharacter(Character)

	for _, Object in ipairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do

		if Object:IsA("BasePart") then
			Object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1

		elseif Object:IsA("Decal") or Object:IsA("Texture") then
			Object.Transparency = 1
		end
	end
end

local function KeepCharacterHidden(Character)

	task.spawn(function()

		while Character.Parent do

			for _, Object in ipairs(Character:GetDescendants()) do

				if Object:IsA("BasePart") then

					if Object.Name ~= "ClientMorph" then
						Object.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
					end

				elseif Object:IsA("Decal") or Object:IsA("Texture") then
					Object.Transparency = 1
				end
			end

			task.wait(0.5)
		end
	end)
end

--==================================================
-- CREATE MORPH
--==================================================

local function CreateMorph(Character)

	local Root =
		Character:WaitForChild(
			"HumanoidRootPart",
			10
		)

	if not Root then
		warn("Morph: HumanoidRootPart not found")
		return
	end

	local OldMorph =
		Character:FindFirstChild("ClientMorph")

	if OldMorph then
		OldMorph:Destroy()
	end

	HideCharacter(Character)
	KeepCharacterHidden(Character)

	local Holder = Instance.new("Part")

	Holder.Name = "ClientMorph"
	Holder.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 2)

	Holder.Transparency = 0

	Holder.CanCollide = false
	Holder.CanTouch = false
	Holder.CanQuery = false
	Holder.Massless = true
	Holder.CastShadow = false
	Holder.Anchored = false

	Holder.Parent = Character

	local Mesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")

	Mesh.Name = "MorphMesh"

	Mesh.MeshType =
		Enum.MeshType.FileMesh

	Mesh.MeshId = MESH_ID

	Mesh.TextureId =
		CurrentTexture

	Mesh.Scale =
		MESH_SCALE

	Mesh.Parent = Holder

	CurrentMorph = Mesh

	Holder.CFrame =
		Root.CFrame *
		CFrame.new(0, MORPH_Y_OFFSET, 0)

	local Weld = Instance.new("Weld")

	Weld.Name = "MorphWeld"

	Weld.Part0 = Root
	Weld.Part1 = Holder

	Weld.C0 =
		CFrame.new(0, MORPH_Y_OFFSET, 0)

	Weld.Parent = Holder

	NormalWeld = Weld
end

--==================================================
-- STOP GRAB
--==================================================

local function StopGrab()

	GrabEnabled = false

	if GrabWeld then
		GrabWeld:Destroy()
		GrabWeld = nil
	end

	if CurrentMorph and CurrentMorph.Parent then

		local Holder =
			CurrentMorph.Parent

		local Character =
			Player.Character

		local Root =
			Character and
			Character:FindFirstChild(
				"HumanoidRootPart"
			)

		if Root then

			Holder.CFrame =
				Root.CFrame *
				CFrame.new(
					0,
					MORPH_Y_OFFSET,
					0
				)

			local Weld =
				Instance.new("Weld")

			Weld.Name = "MorphWeld"

			Weld.Part0 = Root
			Weld.Part1 = Holder

			Weld.C0 =
				CFrame.new(
					0,
					MORPH_Y_OFFSET,
					0
				)

			Weld.Parent = Holder

			NormalWeld = Weld
		end
	end

	-- Restore camera
	CameraFollowing = false

	Camera.CameraType =
		Enum.CameraType.Custom

	local Character =
		Player.Character

	local Humanoid =
		Character and
		Character:FindFirstChildOfClass(
			"Humanoid"
		)

	if Humanoid then
		Camera.CameraSubject = Humanoid
	end
end

--==================================================
-- START GRAB
--==================================================

local function StartGrab(TargetPlayer)

	if not CurrentMorph then
		return false
	end

	if not TargetPlayer then
		return false
	end

	local TargetCharacter =
		TargetPlayer.Character

	if not TargetCharacter then
		return false
	end

	local Hand =
		TargetCharacter:FindFirstChild(
			"RightHand"
		)
		or TargetCharacter:FindFirstChild(
			"Right Arm"
		)

	if not Hand then
		return false
	end

	local Holder =
		CurrentMorph.Parent

	if not Holder then
		return false
	end

	if NormalWeld then
		NormalWeld:Destroy()
		NormalWeld = nil
	end

	if GrabWeld then
		GrabWeld:Destroy()
		GrabWeld = nil
	end

	SelectedPlayer =
		TargetPlayer

	GrabEnabled = true

	Holder.CFrame =
		Hand.CFrame *
		CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)

	local Weld =
		Instance.new("Weld")

	Weld.Name = "GrabWeld"

	Weld.Part0 = Hand
	Weld.Part1 = Holder

	Weld.C0 =
		CFrame.new(0, -0.5, 0)

	Weld.Parent = Holder

	GrabWeld = Weld

	-- Camera follows target
	CameraFollowing = true

	Camera.CameraType =
		Enum.CameraType.Custom

	local TargetHumanoid =
		TargetCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass(
			"Humanoid"
		)

	if TargetHumanoid then
		Camera.CameraSubject =
			TargetHumanoid
	else
		Camera.CameraSubject =
			TargetCharacter
	end

	return true
end

local StartPosition

Title.InputBegan:Connect(function(Input)

	if Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
		or Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		Dragging = true
		DragStart = Input.Position
		StartPosition = Main.Position

		Input.Changed:Connect(function()

			if Input.UserInputState ==
				Enum.UserInputState.End then

				Dragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)

	if not Dragging then
		return
	end

	if Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local Delta =
			Input.Position - DragStart

		Main.Position =
			UDim2.new(
				StartPosition.X.Scale,
				StartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
				StartPosition.Y.Scale,
				StartPosition.Y.Offset + Delta.Y
			)
	end
end)

		GrabStartPosition = GrabFrame.Position

		Input.Changed:Connect(function()

			if Input.UserInputState ==
				Enum.UserInputState.End then

				GrabDragging = false
			end
		end)
	end
end)

UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(Input)

	if not GrabDragging then
		return
	end

	if Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement
		or Input.UserInputType ==
		Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

		local Delta =
			Input.Position - GrabDragStart

		GrabFrame.Position =
			UDim2.new(

				GrabStartPosition.X.Offset + Delta.X,
				GrabStartPosition.Y.Scale,

end)

scripts.script:
if not game:IsLoaded() then
	game.Loaded:Wait()
end

disabled = false
if disabled then
    print("[ETDFarm] disabled.")
    return
end

local expectedID = 95095409824456
local lobbyID = 109792243252518

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer

if game.PlaceId == lobbyID then
	print("[ETDFarm] Lobby detected.")

	local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

	local PVEMapSelectionHUD = playerGui:WaitForChild("PVEMapSelectionHUD")
	local TeleporterHUD = PVEMapSelectionHUD:WaitForChild("Main")

	local target = CFrame.new(270, 79, -18)

	if TeleporterHUD.Visible then
		print("[ETDFarm] Teleporter HUD is already visible.")
	else
		print("[ETDFarm] Teleporter HUD is not visible.")
	end

	while not TeleporterHUD.Visible do
		local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()

		print("[ETDFarm] Teleporter HUD not detected, moving to teleporter...")
		character:PivotTo(target)

		task.wait(1)
	end

	print("[ETDFarm] Teleporter HUD detected. Teleporter entered successfully.")
    print("[ETDFarm] Now creating lobby through remote.")

    wait(0.25)


    local LobbyQueueRemotes = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("LobbyQueueRemotes")
    local CreateLobby = LobbyQueueRemotes:WaitForChild("Action")
    CreateLobby:FireServer(
        "CreateLobby",
        {
            EntryKey = "PVEEndless",
            Difficulty = "Easy"
        }
    )

	return
elseif game.PlaceId ~= expectedID then
	print("[ETDFarm] Neither supported PlaceId matched.")
	return
end

print("[ETDFarm] PVE dungeon detected.")

-- PVE farming code continues here

local playerGui = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
local DefeatHUD = playerGui:WaitForChild("DefeatHUD")
local DefeatPanel = DefeatHUD:WaitForChild("DefeatPanel")

local PlaceTurret = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("PlaceTurret")

print("[ETDFarm] Placing first turret...")

PlaceTurret:FireServer(
	30,
	Vector3.new(
		30.053581237792969,
		-1.8477439880371094e-06,
		73.795402526855469
	)
)

task.wait(0.25)

print("[ETDFarm] Placing second turret...")

PlaceTurret:FireServer(
	30,
	Vector3.new(
		29.953615188598633,
		5.9604644775390625e-08,
		2.1082391738891602
	)
)

print("[ETDFarm] Setting gamespeed to 2.")

local SetGameSpeed = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("SetGameSpeed")

SetGameSpeed:FireServer(2)

print("[ETDFarm] Turrets placed & GameSpeed set. Monitoring DefeatPanel...")

local playtries = 0
while true do
    local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
    local lobbyID = 109792243252518
	if DefeatPanel.Visible then
		print("[ETDFarm] DefeatPanel detected. Attempting PlayAgain in 3 seconds...")

		task.wait(3)

		if DefeatPanel.Visible then
			print("[ETDFarm] Firing PlayAgain...")

			local GameOverAction = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("GameOverAction")
			GameOverAction:FireServer("PlayAgain")
            playtries += 1
		end
	end

    if playtries >= 5 then
        TeleportService:Teleport(lobbyID, player)
        return
    end

	task.wait(0.25)
end

scripts.features:
NOVAX Invisible — a clean, modern FE invisibility script for PC and Mobile.

FEATURES
• Universal — made to run in most games
• No key, no ads, no links to click
• One-tap draggable button, or press G (you can rebind the key)
• 3 versions (V1 / V2 / V3): each hides your character with a different
  method. If it doesn't work in your game, switch version from the menu
• Smooth fade in/out + adjustable see-through level for your own view
• Auto-visible timer (15 / 30 / 60 seconds)
• Resize the button, lock its position, auto-dim, collapse it to a small orb
• 5 color themes (including Rainbow) and a built-in "?" guide
• Mobile friendly: joystick-safe dragging, no keyboard needed
• Saves your settings (needs an executor with writefile; works without it too)

HOW TO USE
1. Join a game, then execute the script
2. Tap the button (or press G) to turn invisibility on/off
3. Open the menu → "?" for a guide to every setting

IMPORTANT
 • If it doesn't work, try V2 or V3.
•Teated on: [Hide And Seek , Brookhaven and Some of other games too ]
• Tested on: [Delta Excutor] too
• The script only saves your settings to a local file (NOVAX_invisible.json).
  No external requests, no webhooks, no personal data is collected.

CHANGELOG
v1.0 — release

Made by NOVAX
